visual.general_description: Three unlabeled microscopy images stacked as one wide upper image and two lower images side by side, showing stained bone marrow-type material at low and higher magnification.
visual.detailed_description: The upper image is wide and shows pink-purple stained tissue with many rounded pale or white vacuole-like spaces of varying size set in a pink-red background, and a large solid pink region with a dark purple edge near the left center; a brown-red band lies along the left edge and white gaps appear near the top and right edges. The lower-left image is a higher-magnification field of purple-blue stained rounded cells and nuclei of varying size on a violet background, with a few pale green-blue areas. The lower-right image is a similar purple-blue field with scattered rounded cells and nuclei, a pale vertical streak near the left center and a lighter upper-left area. No panel letters, arrows, scale bars, magnification labels, stain names or other printed text are visible; the images are low resolution and blurry.
